note: Panorama de ejemplo: los enunciados y la agrupación son CURADOS (simulan el paso de Muse Spark). Cada frase es literal de un abstract y el build comprueba que exista.

claims.statement: La atención permite mirar las partes relevantes de la entrada en lugar de comprimirla en un vector fijo.

evidence.quote: allowing a model to automatically (soft-)search for parts of a source sentence that are relevant to predicting a target word
a global approach which always attends to all source words and a local one that only looks at a subset of source words at a time

claims.statement: La atención sola alcanza: no hacen falta recurrencia ni convoluciones.

evidence.quote: dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely
a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches can perform very well on image classification tasks

claims.statement: El mismo modelo se transfiere a otras tareas y escalas.

evidence.quote: We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks
can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks
scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
attains excellent results compared to state-of-the-art convolutional networks while requiring substantially fewer computational resources to train

claims.statement: El tamaño óptimo del modelo crece con el cómputo de entrenamiento.

evidence.quote: optimally compute-efficient training involves training very large models on a relatively modest amount of data
the model size and the number of training tokens should be scaled equally

claims.statement: Kaplan y Chinchilla recomiendan tasas distintas.

evidence.quote: these laws yield substantially different predictions

claims.statement: La discrepancia se explica por detalles de método.

evidence.quote: much of this discrepancy can be attributed to Kaplan counting non-embedding rather than total parameters
identifying three factors causing the difference: last layer computational cost, warmup duration, and scale-dependent optimizer tuning

claims.statement: Los modelos grandes de entonces estaban subentrenados.

evidence.quote: current large language models are significantly undertrained
